description: A sentence far too long for one line, left-aligned in a wrap column eight tenths of the frame wide. The reference pins where every line breaks and where the block sits: ignoring the wrap width would put one line off both edges, wrapping at the frame's width instead of the column's would move every break, and centring a left-aligned block would slide each line sideways by a different amount. The bottom of the block is also where truncation would show up if a line were dropped.
